answers.question: How has my resting heart rate changed over the last three months?
answers.text: Over the period from Wed Jun 3 to Mon Aug 31, your resting heart rate has remained fairly stable. The overall average was 72 bpm, with a baseline average of 72 bpm and a recent average of 72 bpm. This represents a relative change of 0.48% from baseline to recent. The values ranged from 68 bpm to 77 bpm, with a standard deviation of 2 bpm. Week by week, it fluctuated slightly: for example, in the week of June 1 it was 74 bpm, in the week of July 6 it was 72 bpm, and in the week of August 17 it was 72 bpm. Overall, the change has been minimal.

Stress ratings were 5 out of 5 on Mon Aug 24, 4 on Tue Aug 25, 4 on Wed Aug 26, 2 on Thu Aug 27, 5 on Sat Aug 29, and 1 on Sun Aug 30. The highest single reading was 197.1 lb and the lowest was 194.4 lb. Overall, your weight remained essentially stable, with a slight dip in early August and a return to near baseline by the end of the period.
